item.title: github: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
item.description:
GitHub updated CodeQL support for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4 because Apple removed Intel (x86_64) code from some system binaries and libraries that CodeQL uses for build tracing. This affects how CodeQL traces builds on these platforms.

  • Source: GitHub
